task.title: Recompute daily aggregates from consistent snapshots and atomically replace them
task.input: analytics-ingest, job-leases, analytics-settings-domain and complete raw-coverage boundaries
task.output: analytics-aggregate; AnalyticsDaily daily/product aggregation services and watermark publication
task.accept: 1) In real PostgreSQL count the same duplicate event once. Aggregation fixes a RepeatableRead snapshot/cutoff; newly arriving events wait for the next round. Deduplicate by navigationId and replace the whole target-day group plus watermark in one transaction; process interruption retains the previous group (E-80, E-81). 2) Reject commits by an old generation or timezoneRevision. Recompute only days whose dayStart is not earlier than complete raw coverage; late events within 48h recompute that day. Outside coverage preserve the old complete values and return partial/unavailable with their original definition, without extending raw retention or reducing counts from fragments (E-82, E-83). 3) Aggregate left-closed/right-open site-IANA days, including 23/25-hour DST and unique midnight membership. Time-zone changes recompute only still-retained events; beyond 30 days retain original labels/unavailable-recomputation state (E-56, E-57, E-58). M5-T8 wires this service into real five-minute scheduling.
